description: For a business's own AI: correct its listing (any field register_business takes), add or remove doors, turn it off or on, hide its score page, or opt out (list, crawl or all), with its claim_token or a proof as register_business asks. With no proof it removes only a listing nobody claimed.

claim_token.description: Given by a successful register_business: proof again for 90 days, for this listing only.

domain.description: The business's domain, as its listing has it, like bikes.example.

doors.description: Doors to add and door URLs to remove; the listing's other doors stay.

add.description: Doors to add, each as register_business's doors take one.

kinds.description: Of ask, quote, book, order: what it answers.

protocol.description: What it speaks, for type "other": like beckn or graphql.

rate_limit.description: Requests a day this door takes, 1 to 20; it only lowers the network's own.

terms_url.description: The door's terms of use, https.

type.description: inbox, mcp, a2a, openapi, api, ucp, acp, nlweb, webhook, other, or platform:<name>. Mail, phone, messaging, forms and web pages are human channels and never doors.

url.description: https, with no user in it.

listing.description: off hides it from search and keeps it in the index.

opt_out.description: Stops the listing (list), the crawl (crawl) or both (all). Without a claim token or a proof it removes only an entry nobody claimed. A business that opted out comes back with a domain or key proof.

scopes.description: One or more of list, crawl and all.

proof.description: Proof the domain is its own, answering the challenge a call without proof gets.

challenge_id.description: The challenge's id, as the answer gave it; none for code.

code.description: code: the 8 digits sent to that address.

email.description: code: an address at exactly the business's own domain (not a subdomain), typed by the owner; never a public mail or internet provider's domain.

method.description: Which of the challenge's ways was used.

score_page.description: hidden takes the business's agentic score result page out of view, its ranks and leaderboards included; shown brings it back. It needs the claim token or a proof, as set does.

set.description: The fields to change: any field register_business takes, as its inputSchema describes it.

name: update_business

outputSchema.description: Every field is described in this tool's outputSchema at https://network.surfingdog.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.

title: Change a business's listing
